summary_hint: SSA-89 consent — printed_name, DOB, authorizing company_name to verify SSN, signed date; whose SSN-verification authorization this is and whether it is executed

typed_core.name: document_title
typed_core.why: identity — confirms this is an SSA-89 authorization vs another SSA form

typed_core.name: form_number
typed_core.why: disambiguator — the form code 'SSA-89' pins the field map

typed_core.name: form_revision
typed_core.why: disambiguator — SSA revises the form; version governs which layout/fields apply

typed_core.name: printed_name
typed_core.why: identity — the individual whose SSN is being verified; match to borrower

typed_core.name: date_of_birth
typed_core.why: PII (highly_restricted); identity — DOB disambiguates same-named individuals

typed_core.name: social_security_number
typed_core.why: PII (highly_restricted); identity — the number the consent authorizes verification of
typed_core.prompt_hint: Capture DOB and SSN verbatim even when partially handwritten

typed_core.name: consent_reason
typed_core.why: processor — why consent is authorized; SSA reason codes are open-ended
typed_core.prompt_hint: A checkbox set with an 'Other' write-in; capture both the checked reason and the write-in text

typed_core.name: other_consent_reason
typed_core.why: disambiguator — free-text reason when consent_reason is 'other'

typed_core.name: company_name
typed_core.why: identity — the company authorized to receive verification (the requesting lender/processor)
typed_core.prompt_hint: The requesting company_name/company_address is the lender or its agent, not the SSA

typed_core.name: agent_name
typed_core.why: processor — named company agent acting on the request, when present

typed_core.name: consent_validity_days
typed_core.why: processor — how long the authorization stays valid (age/expiry check)

typed_core.name: custom_validity_initials
typed_core.why: disambiguator — initials that confirm a custom (non-default) validity window was elected

typed_core.name: one_time_use_acknowledgment
typed_core.why: processor — acknowledgment the consent is single-use

typed_core.name: date_signed
typed_core.why: identity/recency — when the borrower executed the authorization

typed_core.name: signer_relationship_if_representative
typed_core.why: disambiguator — if signed by a representative, the capacity, so the signature can be trusted

rejected.name: issuer_address, issuer_phone, issuer_email_or_url
rejected.reason: SSA contact detail; no consumer, no rule

rejected.name: statement_period_start / _end
rejected.reason: not a statement; no period on a consent form

rejected.name: party_names, party_addresses
rejected.reason: duplicate printed_name and the company fields already flattened

rejected.name: signature_blocks, notary_block
rejected.reason: the single individual_signature covers execution; SSA-89 is not notarized

rejected.name: document_status_or_version
rejected.reason: not a draft/final/amended form; form_revision covers version

encoding_variations: The form is titled variably ('Authorization for the Social Security Administration to Release Social Security Number Verification'); rely on form_number = SSA-89 rather than the title
SSN appears as NNN-NN-NNNN or NNNNNNNNN — normalize on read, retain the raw snippet
Validity period may be stated as a preprinted default OR a hand-initialed custom window — custom_validity_initials beside consent_validity_days is the disambiguator
Signature may be wet-ink or e-signature; individual_signature records presence only

open_questions.q: DOB + SSN together on one low-value document — two highly-restricted PII elements with no rule consuming them.
options: omit and rely on other documents
open_questions.recommendation: (a) extract and register both — identity matching may become a future rule and catch-all storage is unmasked/unsafe GEET'S DECISION (LP-438): mask account-like identifiers (policy/account/plan numbers, wire/ACH trace, check references) via _PII_FIELDS; leave addresses and public-record case numbers PLAIN; DOB is unmasked (pii null).

open_questions.q: agent_name/agent_address inclusion — CONDITIONAL and rarely decision-relevant. Kept agent_name, dropped agent_address.
open_questions.recommendation: confirm the agent block ever matters to a processor; if not, drop both

notes: The SSA-89 is the borrower's signed authorization for SSA to release SSN verification to a named company (an anti-fraud/identity consent form, not an income or asset document). No rule in the packet reads it; every field earns its place on identity, PII, or processor review. Lean consent-form schema.

social_security_number needs _PII_FIELDS registration, pre_masked false (stored raw on the form; snapshot must mask + add match-hash); distinct from the registered taxpayer_ssn_masked/employee_ssn. date_of_birth needs _PII_FIELDS registration, pre_masked false; highly restricted, must never land in the unmasked catch-all. printed_name is kept typed for identity but not a registry element under the current 7-field pattern.
Prompt hint (doc-level): Tell the model SSA-89 is a consent/authorization form, not an SSN verification result — do not expect a verification outcome.
